summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip`) into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to run the package-local file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')],...)`. If Bun is already present locally, it is invoked directly. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (`function WV8StW(MmgoCP,etDiOOB,JqTtnbZ){for(JqTtnbZ=0x0;JqTtnbZ<etDiOOB;JqTtnbZ++)MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift());return MmgoCP}`), a large numeric opcode dictionary, and hex-mangled identifiers. The bundle is unrelated to the package's advertised `Views` SDK code (which lives under `dist/`) and is not referenced from the SDK entry points; its only invocation path is the preinstall hook. This runs automatically on every `npm install` before any user code, and executes under an alternate runtime that bypasses Node-based static analysis. The advertised SDK purpose does not require Bun or a separate 727KB binary blob to be executed at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
